project_info.name: Galio AI Studio
project_info.vibe: Premium, minimal, functional, sleek, similar to Hercules AI / Cursor / Bolt
project_info.core_goal: Provide a high-end, distraction-free environment for AI-assisted website generation and editing.

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for all headings.

code.usage: Use for the code editor panel, file explorer items, and terminal logs.

strategy.description: Monochrome high-contrast design. Everything structural is shades of dark zinc. Actions are pure white. Avoid generic blue gradients.
strategy.accents: Use pure white or 10% white (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)) for glows and active states. AI highlights should use subtle white glows, not neon colors, to maintain a premium studio feel.

workspace_grid.description: 3-panel bento grid for the Studio view. Full viewport height (h-screen).
workspace_grid.left_panel: AI chat and workflow modes. Strict vertical flex, border-r border-zinc-800.
workspace_grid.center_panel: Live preview canvas area. Background is dotted or darker (#000) to frame the preview window.
workspace_grid.right_panel: Code/Files panel. border-l border-zinc-800, using monospace font.

alignment.text: Left-align dense content and chat messages. Center-align only the main landing page hero.
alignment.icons: Optical alignment (padding adjustments) to perfectly center icons within buttons.

surfaces_and_borders.panels: Solid background (bg-zinc-950), no shadows, 1px subtle inner border.
surfaces_and_borders.cards: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg hover:border-zinc-700 transition-colors
surfaces_and_borders.glassmorphism: Used only for floating toolbars (Device toggles, Top Navigation): bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-zinc-800/50.

components_strategy.navigation: Sticky top bar, z-50, backdrop-blur-md, containing project title, utility buttons, and Export/Deploy CTAs.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-zinc-950 hover:bg-zinc-200 font-medium px-4 py-2
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-800 text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 px-4 py-2
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2

components_strategy.ai_chat: Chat bubbles should be distinguishable: User (bg-zinc-800 text-white), AI (bg-transparent text-zinc-300, border-l-2 border-white pl-4).
components_strategy.preview_canvas: A scaled frame in the center panel. Wrap the frame in a subtle border ring (ring-1 ring-zinc-800). Add a top device toolbar (Desktop/Tablet/Mobile).
components_strategy.shadcn: Use Shadcn components for Dropdowns, Dialogs, Selects, and Tabs. Customize them to remove Vercel defaults (replace rounded corners to match our scale, darken borders).
components_strategy.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. They match the strict, geometric look of developer tools.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons must change background color slightly. Text color must shift from secondary to primary on hover.
motion_and_interactions.active_states: Use transform scale-95 for button clicks.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use a minimal pulsing text or a simple CSS spinner. Avoid complex or childish loading animations.

brand_logo.usage: Top left of navigation bar and landing page header.

hero_background.description: Abstract dark 3D geometry representing AI workflow
hero_background.usage: Use as a background cover with a bg-black/60 overlay for the Landing Page hero section.

user_avatars.usage: User profile dropdown trigger on the top right navigation.

views_and_pages.landing_page: Hero section with absolute background image (with heavy dark overlay). Massive Geist H1 heading. White 'Start Building' CTA. Sleek and minimal.
views_and_pages.dashboard: Project list page. Grid layout. Each card represents a project with a placeholder cover, project name, last edited time. Includes 'New Project' card.

ai_studio_workspace.header: Contains logo, current project title, Undo/Redo icons, Device toggles, 'Export ZIP', 'GitHub Push', 'Deploy Vercel', 'Publish' CTAs.
ai_studio_workspace.left_panel: Tabbed modes (Plan, Build, Debug, Refine). Chat interface. Prompts text area pinned to bottom.
ai_studio_workspace.center_panel: A nested div structure representing the browser frame. Dynamic width based on Desktop/Tablet/Mobile selection.
ai_studio_workspace.right_panel: Collapsible tree view for files. Code editor area with JetBrains Mono, syntax highlighting colors (using base colors).

instructions_to_main_agent: MUST use pure HTML/Tailwind for the landing page layout and complex workspace grid structuring.
MUST install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons.
MUST add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements, e.g., data-testid='deploy-vercel-btn'.
MUST strictly adhere to the monochromatic palette (bg-zinc-950, border-zinc-800, text-zinc-50). Do not introduce unapproved colors.
MUST use Geist and JetBrains Mono fonts. Ensure they are loaded/imported via next/font or standard CSS imports.
Mock the GitHub Push and Vercel Deploy actions with a toast notification (e.g., using 'sonner'). Highlight 'mocked' in the UI logs.
Build the Workspace using flex/grid rules specified in 'layout_and_spacing'. Ensure the center preview canvas scales gracefully.
